cell-is-the-band-s: A cell is the band’s wins at that tier over its battles there, across every vehicle a player has at least {minBattles} battles on, so it describes the tiers as played by the people who play them. Cells resting on fewer than {TIERWINRATETHINCELL} battles are drawn faintly: they move for reasons other than skill. The colours are the same win-rate bands the site uses everywhere else.
nothing-recorded: Nothing recorded against {metric} yet. The grid is rebuilt nightly.
